title: peristylus neotineoides
intro: Peristylus neotineoides, commonly known as the "orchid", is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Peristylus neotineoides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
